management.title: Management cluster unreachable
management.description: Management cluster is unreachable. DevDeploy platform services may be unstable. Run launcher preflight.
management.recovery: The management cluster hosts the DevDeploy platform, Postgres, and Argo CD. Recreating it may cause data loss. Try launcher preflight and Docker/WSL restart steps first.
management.impact: Do not recreate devdeploy-mgmt unless platform data is backed up or you have accepted local data loss.

workload.title: Workload cluster unreachable
workload.description: Workload cluster is unreachable. Runtime status, untracked resources, and reconcile checks may be unavailable. Run launcher preflight.
workload.recovery: First run wsl --shutdown and fully restart Docker Desktop. If the issue persists, recreate only the devdeploy-workload cluster. The management cluster and database are preserved.
workload.impact: If the workload cluster is recreated, runtime resources in that cluster may be lost; DevDeploy records and GitOps manifests are preserved.

recovery.title: Recovery guidance
recovery.guidanceOnly: These steps are guidance only. DevDeploy does not run recovery or destructive commands automatically.
